items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Had a chance to meet him in Savannah, Georgia.

ctx.x: Oh, you did. Who was he with then?

He was by himself. They were doing things like they'd thank come out of town, than you, Baby, they'd come out of town. They'd come from Chicago. They might have been working with -- I don't know. No, I think it was Carol Dickerson's band but they might have been working with Joe Oliver during that time but I thought Joe Oliver was a great trumpet player. Had a chance to meet him in Savannah, Georgia. some years ago.
You did? Who were you down there with?
